description: Use this when the host gives the name their invite emails should carry without being asked for it. Do not use this to guess a name, to save a participant's or anyone else's name, to rename an interview, or to change the host's email address or other account details. Save the host's name: invite emails name the host by it, and replies go to the host's email address. Inviting people and creating an interview no longer need it: when the account has no name, those tools take the host's name as host_name and save it only when the approved action runs. Ask the host for a name only when a reply says needs_input. It sends nothing, saves only the name, leaves everything else on the account as it is, and needs no confirmation. Saving the same name again changes nothing.

name.description: The host's name, as the people they invite should see it. Example: Linh Do.

name: set_host_name
title: Set the host's name
